path.description: Report file written by the validation agent
path.title: Path

underlying.description: Equity ticker, index code or commodity code
underlying.title: Underlying

units_per_share.description: Units of the underlying per fund share
units_per_share.title: Units Per Share

fixed_coupon.description: Running coupon as a decimal, e.g. 0.01
fixed_coupon.title: Fixed Coupon

CSA.description: Credit support annex terms. Amounts in ``collateral_currency``.
CSA.title: CSA

commodity.description: e.g. BRENT, WTI, NATGAS, GOLD, COPPER
commodity.title: Commodity

CommodityOption.description: Vanilla option on a commodity future, Black on the curve price at expiry.
CommodityOption.title: CommodityOption

rating.description: External or internal rating, e.g. A+, NR
rating.title: Rating

CounterpartyReference.title: CounterpartyReference

name.description: e.g. USD Rates, G10 FX, Index Equity
name.title: Name

ETF.description:
Exchange-traded fund priced by look-through: NAV per share = Σ units × price, times
one plus the tracking spread.
ETF.title: ETF

EquityExotic.description: Continuously monitored barrier option or cash-or-nothing digital on an equity or index.
EquityExotic.title: EquityExotic

coupon_rate.description: Annual coupon as a decimal, e.g. 0.0425
coupon_rate.title: Coupon Rate

InterestRateFuture.description: Three-month money-market future quoted 100 − rate; 1bp = notional × 0.25 × 0.0001.
InterestRateFuture.title: InterestRateFuture

fixed_rate.description: Annual fixed rate as a decimal
fixed_rate.title: Fixed Rate

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, DE
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

MutualFund.description: Open-ended fund priced by look-through with a cash sleeve; dealt through a transfer agent.

cash_per_share.description: Cash sleeve per share in fund currency
cash_per_share.title: Cash Per Share

MutualFund.title: MutualFund

NettingSet.description: Trades that net under one agreement with one counterparty and one of our entities.
NettingSet.title: NettingSet

Organisation.description: A complete organisation with referential integrity enforced on construction.
Organisation.title: Organisation

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details, plus ``code`` so clients branch on a stable token.

instance.description: Request path that raised the problem
instance.title: Instance

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type
type.title: Type

Problem.title: Problem

source.description: Proxy family or factor the value came from
source.title: Source

Repo.description:
Repo (we borrow cash against collateral) or reverse repo (we lend cash). ``direction``
on the trade decides: BUY = reverse repo (cash lent, asset), SELL = repo (cash borrowed).
Repo.title: Repo

RunFigures.description: Headline figures stored with the run record (reporting currency).
RunFigures.title: RunFigures

RunSummary.description: The morning screen in one call: run record plus the four things to look at first.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

SACCRNettingRow.description: Add-ons by hedging set arrive as extra ``addon_<class>`` fields.
SACCRNettingRow.title: SACCRNettingRow

SIMMRow.description: Margin by risk class arrives as extra fields named after the class.
SIMMRow.title: SIMMRow

StressRow.description: One scenario; when grouped, each group's P&L is an extra field named after the group.
StressRow.title: StressRow

Swaption.description: European swaption on a vanilla swap; payer pays fixed on exercise.
Swaption.title: Swaption

Trade.description:
A single trade. Frozen: a trade is a fact; lifecycle changes create a new version.

``quantity`` semantics by product:
- bonds, IRS, CDS index, FX: notional in the instrument currency (signed by direction)
- equities, crypto: number of shares/units
- futures and options: number of contracts (multiplier lives on the instrument)

trade_price.description: Executed price, rate or spread as quoted
trade_price.title: Trade Price

Trade.title: Trade

trade.description: None when the trade left the snapshot
